title: Summit Missing Activity Claim Windows
content:
The Crestline Summit Loyalty Program accepts claims for missing flights and missing partner activity only inside set windows, counted in calendar days. The windows by tier are:

| Tier | Earliest acceptance of a missing Crestline flight claim (calendar days after the flight date) | Latest claim for a missing Crestline flight (calendar days after the flight date) | Latest claim for missing partner activity (calendar days after the activity date) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Summit Member | 3 | 270 | 180 |
| Summit Silver | 3 | 270 | 180 |
| Summit Gold | 3 | 270 | 180 |
| Summit Platinum | 3 | 270 | 180 |
| Summit Diamond | 3 | 365 | 180 |
| Summit Chairman | 3 | 365 | 180 |

The first column exists so that automatic posting can complete before a claim is taken. The second column is the only one that differs between tiers: Summit Diamond and Summit Chairman have 365 calendar days, every other tier 270. Partner activity has 180 calendar days at every tier.

**Hypothetical figures.** For a Crestline flight on a flight date D, a Summit Gold member's claim window closes 270 calendar days after D and a Summit Diamond member's 365 calendar days after D; neither window opens until 3 calendar days after D.
